01

DIR:
FROM CHALKBOARDS TO CHATBOTS

TAPMI Bengaluru · DIR — Diversity, Inclusivity and Rootedness
A Semester 1 DIR project: an ethnographic study of how AI is transforming education, drawing on interviews, observations, informal conversations, and student-faculty interactions to explore changing learning behaviours, AI dependence, teaching methods, and perceptions across disciplines. As part of the team, I contributed to the ethnographic research and to framing the research questions, and learned about qualitative research, observation, and understanding different perspectives.
02

TLM:
AI-POWERED TOURISM MANAGEMENT AGENT

TAPMI Bengaluru · TLM — Technology Literacy for Managers
A Semester 1 TLM project on an AI-powered tourism management agent for family-run lodges in temple towns, designed to analyse booking trends, festival calendars, and demand patterns to support decisions on room pricing, staff allocation, and food inventory. The concept incorporates RAG, MCP, and human approval for operational decisions. I developed the agent’s frontend prototype, and learned how AI agents function and how useful they can be in solving practical business and operational problems.
View Live Prototype ↗
03

LLR:
RHETORIC ANALYSIS AND STRATEGIC REBRANDING

TAPMI Bengaluru · LLR — Language, Literature and Rhetoric
A Semester 1 LLR project analysing a selected speaker’s communication style through the rhetorical principles of ethos, pathos, and logos, evaluating their strengths, audience engagement, and persuasive techniques to develop a strategic rebranding approach that builds on their existing identity. I contributed to the rhetorical analysis, and learned how persuasive communication works and how messaging shapes audience perception.
04

ACCOUNTS:
FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING AND STATEMENT PREPARATION

TAPMI Bengaluru · Accounts — Financial Accounting
A Semester 1 accounting project applying the complete accounting cycle to a listed company, using its annual report as the foundation: simulated business transactions were recorded as journal entries, carried into ledger accounts and trial balances, and compiled into financial statements with year-end adjustments. I contributed to preparing the Income Statement and Balance Sheet, and learned how financial transactions are reflected in financial statements and how businesses assess their financial position and performance.
05

EXCEL DATA TRANSFORMATION
& POWER BI ANALYSIS

TAPMI Bengaluru · Excel & Power BI
A Semester 1 project built around messy, unstructured Excel files that were cleaned and transformed for analysis, then used to create an interactive, three-page Power BI dashboard presenting visualisations and analytical insights. I cleaned and transformed the Excel data and created the Power BI analysis dashboard, and learned how to structure raw data and turn it into meaningful insights through analysis and visualisation.
